purpose: One bounded arbitrary-input-density functional diagnostic excluding the molecular potential from its interface
decision: The strict singlet version failed a later inner state residual while the density residual remained large; no scalar or potential accepted. Do not rerun this protocol with rank, seed, iteration or tolerance changes.
input_density: Saved minus-potential-path noninteracting ensemble density; an oracle-density diagnostic, not a new blind chemistry claim
numerical_backend: Existing preallocated Ritz state/image storage; same mathematical search and tolerances after the separately recorded incomplete-solve interruption
global_spin: Project every trial vector and operator image into S=0 using the exact finite-sector polynomial in S squared; initialization alone does not enforce spin during inverse-potential searches
initialization: Canonical natural-orbital singlet seed; noninteracting density dual minus input-density Hartree/exchange potential; no h, nuclear charges or labels
dual_coordinates: Fixed positive Gaussian occupation covariance from the input density; no learned parameters or hyperparameter sweeps
assessment: Only after the search stops, compare F with the saved physical-potential-path universal value; reject unconverged scalar/potential outputs
limits: Implicit universal search rather than an amortized predictor
Oracle input density, not self-consistent prediction
Singlet sector and shared physical Hamiltonian primitives
No broad chemistry score or speed work
